en.description:
VirtuBand is a music studio that fits in your pocket. Play eight synthesised instruments with your fingers, arrange a song in sections and play it back on a step sequencer, record takes with your microphone, and start from a genre drum pattern or a common chord progression when you cannot find the next part.

—— Play ——

Eight synthesised instruments — piano, guitar, bass, violin, drums, synth, flute and saxophone — each with its own playable surface rather than one generic keyboard: piano keys, a 12-fret fingerboard, eight drum pads, an XY pad for synth pitch and filter, and wind keys with a breath slider. Every sound is generated on your device, so it works offline.

—— Arrange ——

STUDIO
Pick which instruments play, set the tempo, and press Play: a 16-step sequencer plays them through your song sections in order, following each section's key.

TRACKS
Build the song structure by adding and removing sections such as verse, chorus, bridge and outro. The Studio plays them in order.

—— Record ——

RECORDINGS
Record a take with your microphone. Every take is saved on your device, where you can play it back, rename it, or delete it. Each take is a single microphone recording; VirtuBand does not overdub or mix takes together.

—— Compose ——

AI COMPOSE
Preview a starter drum pattern for pop, hip-hop, jazz or classical, then send it to the Studio as your drum part, and browse common chord progressions. These are built-in templates, not AI-generated.

JAM
Practise along with a metronome on the instrument of your choice, right on the same screen. Jam runs on your device only; there is no online multiplayer.

—— Built to get out of your way ——

• Dashboard summarising your recordings, sections and instruments
• Dark interface designed for playing in low light
• Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as Guest" and every feature is available
• Works offline; nothing you record needs a network to save

en.release_notes:
First release of VirtuBand.

• Eight synthesised instruments, each with its own playable surface
• Studio step sequencer that plays your song sections in order
• Microphone recordings you can replay, rename and delete
• Genre drum templates you can preview and use in the Studio, plus common chord progressions
• Jam mode: practise on an instrument along with a metronome
• Works offline; sign-in is optional via "Continue as Guest"

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
VirtuBand is a music studio that fits in your pocket. Play eight synthesised instruments with your fingers, arrange a song in sections and play it back on a step sequencer, record takes with your microphone, and start from a genre drum pattern or a common chord progression when you cannot find the next part.

Intended audience:
People who want to play, arrange and record music on a phone or tablet without other gear.

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is not needed: tap "Continue as Guest" and every feature is available, so no demo account is required. Studio: toggle instruments and press Play to hear the sequencer; long-press an instrument to play it. Recordings: record, play back, rename and delete takes. AI Compose: preview a drum template and tap "Use ... Beat in Studio". Jam: pick an instrument, Start Practice, Start Jamming.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — optional email/password sign-in only; no user content is stored in Supabase
- Google AdMob — advertising, Android build only (the iOS build shows no ads)
- Google Firebase — Crashlytics crash reports, Analytics and Performance Monitoring

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The interface language can be set to 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish); it starts in the device language when that is one of them. Navigation, screen headings and shared controls are translated; the remaining in-app text is currently English. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app does not offer account creation, so there is no in-app account deletion: sign-in is optional and only accepts an existing account. All studio content and recordings are stored on the device and are removed by deleting the app. Account deletion requests can be sent to contact@americangroup.ai.
